Maya (PM): quick sync? We need to finalize PRD acceptance criteria for the 'Optimize toolkit' RFCs (batching/caching/quant). Customer asks piling up.
Li (ML Eng): yep. biggest ask: per-tenant batching configs + fallback to non-batched low-latency path.
Trent (Infra): agree. need autoscaler + backpressure signals. also how do we instrument queue depth? :thinking_face:
Ana (Eval): acceptance criteria proposal:
```
- 95th p50 token latency <= target for non-batched path
- 95th p95 token latency within 2x for batched path
- unit cost reduction > 20% on sample workloads
- no correctness regressions on eval set
```
Sam (Product): add: explicit rollback criteria if quality drops > 1% on production prompts.
Li (ML Eng): edge cases: mixed-size prompts, KV cache warmup, quantized model mismatch on rare tokens. doc them.
Josh (Solutions): customers will ask for a config UI and per-route overrides. tracker ticket?
Maya (PM): created tracker TG-1823. can we get final PRD bullets by EOD Friday? please add short A/C in the doc.
Trent (Infra): I'll draft the ops SLOs and an example config snippet:
```
optimize:
  batching:
    max_batch_size: 64
    max_wait_ms: 8
  fallback: true
```
Ana (Eval): I'll run regression suite on quantized vs float32 and share results.
Li (ML Eng): I'll write the RFC section about compatibility matrix and graceful degradation.
deploy-bot: scheduled a follow-up meeting on 2026-03-25 16:00 UTC
